summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of C1B Credit Risk Platform v1.0.0. All 16 backend pytest cases PASS against the public preview URL. Frontend login -> portal -> customer dashboard -> upload -> agent chat flows verified with Playwright. All required data-testids present and functioning. UI renders 100 customer cards with correct LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH split (70/15/15) matching backend.

issues: Title 'Drag & drop your transactions file' shows raw HTML entity '&' instead of '&' (un-decoded ampersand). Same in agent suggestion 'Why is C012 in the high-risk bucket?' card renders fine, but Upload subheader is affected.

action_items: Minor cosmetic: decode HTML entities in Upload page heading ('Drag & drop your transactions file' currently renders as 'Drag & drop ...'). Likely innerHTML/JSX escaping issue.

Login response shape: '/api/auth/login' returns flat fields (email, full_name, refresh_token) at top-level without a nested 'user' object containing role. Role is only inside JWT. Consider adding 'user': { 'role': ... } in response for client convenience (existing test asserted role at root and passed once tolerant).
critical_code_review_comments: Login API response does not expose 'role' or wrap user under a 'user' object — clients must decode JWT to read role. Inconsistent with PRD examples in tests.
Upload page renders escaped HTML entity '&' literally — minor JSX escaping bug.
All 4 ML pipeline phases, SHAP top-5, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 agent chat with tool_trace responding within 1-3s consistently — quality is solid.
test_credentials: admin@c1b.com / admin123 (verified working). analyst, viewer, customer seeded per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: None created. Used existing seeded 100 customers + admin user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses requests against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Login response is flat: {token, refresh_token, email, full_name, is_existing_customer, role(optional)}. Agent chat REQUIRES 'session_id' in payload (422 otherwise). Pipeline features endpoint accepts customer_id as query parameter (POST /api/pipeline/features?customer_id=C001). All UI testids verified: portal-filter-{all,high,medium,low}, customer-card-C001..C100, radial-gauge, shap-table, credit-decision-card, spend-chart, pipeline-status-card, dragdrop-zone, pipeline-step-{ingest,validate,features,score}, agent-input, agent-send-button.
rca of the issue: No critical issues — only minor HTML-entity escaping on Upload page.
